methods.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Efficiently Improving Generalization
methods.saved_conclusion: SAM minimizes an objective involving maximized nearby training loss and updates using a gradient at the selected perturbation. The practical approximation omits the derivative through the perturbation.
methods.attribution: Perturbing weights to change the subsequent training gradient is established.
methods.operation_difference: The conditional candidate minimizes post-own-CE-update pooled loss among centered graph-head covariance allocations and retains those initial contrasts for a served ensemble. It is neither SAM's immediate inner maximization nor its single-model gradient rule.
methods.limits: No paper benefit or i.i.d. bound is transferred; scoped v1 only.

methods.title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Deep Networks
methods.saved_conclusion: MAML learns an initialization using a post-inner-update objective, differentiating through inner updates across tasks.
methods.attribution: Initialization chosen for post-update loss is established bilevel machinery.
methods.operation_difference: The candidate makes a discrete three-way covariance choice within a graph VJP head span, reusing one graph's TRAIN labels for a one-step proxy. No across-task meta-training or meta-gradient update is specified.
methods.limits: No task-generalization result or faithful MAML reproduction is asserted; scoped v1 only.

retained_attribution.boundary: Immediate loss after averaged output differs from subsequent mean-own-CE dynamics. The instantaneous logit-Hessian term vanishes for an affine head. The saved printed-sign discrepancy is not repaired by latest v3 or code qualification here.

retained_attribution.established: Fits additive trees to graph-GNN input-feature updates; one inner step supplies a graph-dependent loss-gradient target.
retained_attribution.boundary: Saved operation is not simultaneous centered private-head covariance initialization by post-update pooled CE.

retained_attribution.established: Squared-error complementary prediction targets; classification examples use one-hot regression.
retained_attribution.boundary: Shared-parameter differentiation and complementary-target detachment need care; no literal shared-factor CE port or exact complete-operation equivalence is established.

composition_assessment.closest_source_specific_operation: Retained graph-error initializer with unconditional graph-band allocation and finite TRAIN guards.
composition_assessment.exact_composition: Graph-conditioned private-head VJP span -> deterministic rank-three basis -> three antithetic rank-two covariance allocations -> matched initial mean logits/Jensen penalty -> one finite own-CE trial -> discrete pooled-CE selection -> original-state native continuation.
composition_assessment.scientific_disposition: Conditional mechanism question, eligible in principle; not rejected by ingredient overlap or present compute availability.
composition_assessment.possible_scoped_contribution: Useful graph-conditioned candidate restriction if equally selected random/permuted spans and fixed graph allocation are beaten on later pooled quality.
